create_epnp_solution: create an EpnpSolution namedtuple containing camera rotation, translation, and reprojection errors
run_efficient_pnp: run efficient_pnp to find camera R and T that minimize 2D reprojection error for 3D-2D point correspondences
compute_barycentric_coords: compute barycentric coordinates of 3D points in a control point frame using _compute_alphas
find_null_space_basis: find the null space basis of the reprojection matrix via eigendecomposition of M^T M
solve_quadratic_pnp: solve the PnP problem by finding null space coordinates via quadratic equation solving for camera pose estimation
